title: Burke's Oasis Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Burke's Oasis is a 2BR/2BA condo located at 29 Quincy Circle, Santa Rosa Beach, FL, 32459, Unit A on the 2nd Floor, in the upscale community of Seaside. We are only steps away from the many shops of Seaside, the amphitheater, and directly across 30A.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Across the street from the George and Coleman Seaside Beach Access - Up to 4 Wrist Bands TOTAL for private beach access (per Seaside guidelines they will not provide us with more bands than the home sleeps) - 2 Adult sized beach cruisers - Walk outside condo to Seaside, shops and restaurants - One marked Parking Spot - Spacious outdoor patio - Fully stocked kitchen - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. --Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($100 fee applies at booking) One of our most popular rentals to get repeat customers, Burke's Oasis is a 2BR/2BA condo located at 29 Quincy Circle, Santa Rosa Beach, FL, 32459, Unit A on the 2nd Floor (elevator access available), in the upscale community of Seaside. We are only steps away from the many shops of Seaside, the amphitheater, and directly across 30A from one of Seaside’s beach accesses and the famous Bud & Alleys Restaurant. As you enter the condo you walk into the open living room and stainless kitchen with breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico. Our living area has a large flat screen TV for your indoor entertainment and the stack-able washer/dryer are hidden in a closet in the hallway. The shared bathroom has a shower/tub combo and door to the Queen Guest bedroom. The Queen Master is just beyond the kitchen with its own private bath. The fully equipped kitchen offers stainless appliances overlooking the living room. An outdoor balcony offers dining for 4 with beautiful unobstructed ocean views! Come for a weekend getaway or stay for the week. Burke's oasis is sure to be your oasis when you stay here. If you are traveling with a larger group, check out our sister condo Truman's Hideout right next door for additional sleeping arrangements! ACCOMODATIONS: (Sleeps 4) Bedroom 1: Queen bed, TV, private bathroom, shower only Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV, hall bathroom tub/shower combo IMPORTANT DETAILS: ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. ** No pets allowed ** Comes with 2 complimentary bikes * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. FREE Wi-Fi

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
